items.title: tencent/Hy4 · Hugging Face
items.summary: A large technology firm released the full weights of its flagship Hy4 model (770B total parameters, 49B active per token, 1M-token context), its FP8 version and the pre-trained base. The model card calls Hy4 one of the strongest open-weight models available but says a notable gap remains to top proprietary models on research-level maths, long-horizon coding and model self-improvement.
items.detail: Tencent Hy Team, Hugging Face model card updated 2026-11-20; also on ModelScope and GitCode. Released under the Tencent Hy License (derived from Apache 2.0; model-as-a-service operators above a revenue threshold or 100 million monthly users need a separate licence).
items.reasoning: A new flagship open-weight release bears on how far open weights trail the frontier (I-R5-02), but no Epoch Capabilities Index score is available yet to place it.
items.counterpoint: The developer itself reports a notable gap to top proprietary models, and the licence restricts large API providers, so the release may not narrow the open/closed gap or widen diffusion as much as the headline suggests.
